classification.difficultyReason: Read the base and perpendicular height from the diagram, form their area product, solve the quadratic and retain physically valid dimensions.

content.prompt: The area of the parallelogram is $22\text{ cm}^2$. Find its length and perpendicular height.

spec.description: Unfilled parallelogram with horizontal opposite edges, sloping sides, a dashed perpendicular from the upper-left vertex to the lower edge, and a right-angle marker at its foot. Source yellow fill and orange strokes are replaced by unfilled black geometry under house style.
spec.mathematics: Top edge is labelled (y + 9) cm; perpendicular height is labelled y cm. Diagram coordinates establish topology only and are not numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied variable labels are visible in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Area $=\text{base}\times\text{perpendicular height}$.
$$\begin{aligned}y(y+9)&=22\\y^2+9y-22&=0\\(y+11)(y-2)&=0\\y&=-11\text{ or }2\end{aligned}$$
Reject $y=-11$ because a height must be positive. The perpendicular height is $2\text{ cm}$ and the length is $(2+9)\text{ cm}=11\text{ cm}$. Check: $11\times2=22\text{ cm}^2$.
